Motorola provides the following software support schedule for the Motorola Razr 50 (also known as the Razr 2024 in the US):Major Android OS Updates: 3 years. The device originally launched with Android 14, meaning its final major operating system upgrade will be Android 17. Security Updates: 4 years of regular security patches. Because the phone launched in June 2024, its official security support is scheduled to end on June 30, 2028. While Motorola has recently begun extending support up to 5 or 7 years for select newer models, the Razr 50 remains on their standard 3-year OS upgrade cycle, which falls short of the longer lifecycles offered by competitors like Samsung and Google for their premium foldables.
